page.layout: One column of running text; in the left margin, notes beside the paragraphs. Printed page 316 at the top left, running head "LIBRI SECVNDI" at the top right, catchword "natur" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters]VERITAS est adæquatio notionum, quæ sunt in intellectu cum rebus.
FALSITAS est in notionibus, quæ sunt in mente ideò, quod eæ rebus non sint adæquatæ.
DianoëticaDianoëtica est, cum mens unum ex alio deducendo & ab uno ad aliud transeundo plura noëmata disponit.
RatiocinatioRatiocinatio est mentis discursus, ex trium noematum discursu necessariam consequentiam inferens. Hac judicatur consequentia & inconsequentia.

OrdinatioOrdinatio est discursus mentis, quo mens compositas è noematis sententias discurrens, eas sibi cognatas pro naturæ suæ luce & claritate collocat, & in ordinem redigit. Hac judicatur Ordo & Confusio.
Tertia intellectus divisioIII. Intellectus est Contemplativus, vel Practicus.
Intellectus contemplativus tantùm intelligit & ratiocinatur propter cognitionem, ut res vere cognoscat.

page.notes: The top-left margin note is blurred and unreadable. The signature at the bottom left is faint and only partly legible. Some words in the text are slightly blurred by show-through from the other side of the leaf; I have transcribed only the readable letters. The word "ratiocinatur" at the end of the last line runs over into the catchword area; the printed line ends with "ratioci-" and the catchword is "natur".
